description: Isolate makeReviewDispatch reviewer-backend resolution from the live project.toml via a test-facing injection seam so the codex reviewer backend becomes CI-testable.

userStories.title: Add reviewer-backend resolution seam to makeReviewDispatch and isolate the generic tests
userStories.description: As a cam maintainer, I need makeReviewDispatch's reviewer-backend/model resolution to be injectable per-call so the ~41 generic dispatch tests stop reading the repo's live scripts/cam/project.toml, letting a codex reviewer backend be validated in CI without codex auth.
acceptanceCriteria: MakeReviewDispatchOptions gains a documented test-facing seam that overrides reviewer-backend/model resolution (a pre-resolved reviewBackend/reviewModel override, or a projectConfigPath threaded into the readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel calls at src/supervisor/review.ts:354-355); when set, makeReviewDispatch uses the seam instead of reading the live project.toml; when unset it resolves from the live project.toml exactly as before. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The seam is threaded through the single production consumer at src/commands/sidecar.ts:1529 with runtime behavior unchanged: with the seam unset, makeReviewDispatch still resolves the reviewer backend from the live scripts/cam/project.toml in production. [oracle: grep -q 'readPhaseBackend' src/supervisor/review.ts]

The generic makeDispatchOpts-based tests in test/supervisor/review.test.ts supply the injection seam (e.g. via the shared makeDispatchOpts helper at review.test.ts:269) and no longer depend on the repo's live scripts/cam/project.toml [backend].reviewer value. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The 10 existing codex/container tests that use withReviewerBackendCwd (review.test.ts:347) still pass unchanged (that real-temp-project.toml + chdir pattern is retained for argv-shape tests needing a real agent file on disk). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/review.test.ts]

A regression test asserts that when the resolved config would select reviewer=codex, the generic dispatch path using the injected seam does not fail with codex-auth-failed. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/review.test.ts]
The committed scripts/cam/project.toml reviewer backend value is unchanged (this issue makes codex CI-testable, it does not switch the default). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The full review test suite passes. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/review.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Vertical slice, 3 files: src/supervisor/review.ts (add seam to MakeReviewDispatchOptions ~line 280, apply it in makeReviewDispatch at lines 354-355 where reviewBackend=readPhaseBackend('reviewer') and reviewModel=readPhaseModel('reviewer',undefined,reviewBackend) are resolved), src/commands/sidecar.ts (production wiring at line 1529; leave the seam unset so live resolution is preserved), test/supervisor/review.test.ts (thread the seam through the shared makeDispatchOpts helper at line 269 so all ~41 generic tests inherit isolation; add the codex regression test). Recommended seam design (merit): thread an optional projectConfigPath through to readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel, which ALREADY accept an optional configPath param documented for tests (src/config/models.ts:265,158) - this exercises the real resolution path against a fixture rather than bypassing resolution; a pre-resolved reviewBackend/reviewModel override is the simpler alternative. GOTCHA (issue): mocking the auth preflight (codexAuthCheckFn->authenticated:true) is a FALSE fix - the backend still resolves to codex and routes through CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv which reads .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md and re-breaks; the seam MUST override backend RESOLUTION, not just the auth check. codexAuthCheckFn (review.ts:280) already exists but cannot change reviewBackend, so it is insufficient alone. Do NOT remove withReviewerBackendCwd (review.test.ts:347): the 10 codex/container argv-shape tests still need the real on-disk project.toml + agent file. Do NOT commit [backend].reviewer=codex into scripts/cam/project.toml. COHERENCE: review.ts and sidecar.ts are sidecar-executed, so a binary rebuild is required after ship for the change to take effect in a live loop. No external library touched; no vendor/templates change. Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for the review-dispatch DI-seam precedents (codexAuthCheckFn US-002 CAM-352, readReviewReport US-002 CAM-75, warnFn US-004 CAM-75) which model the same optional-seam/backward-compat contract.
